arguments.command:
cd /tmp/shurik-workspace-ZfhcNR && git config user.name; git config user.email; git add -A && git commit -q -m "fix: repair parser stdlib collision, gap classification and Hebrew fixtures

- _ImageCollector shadowed HTMLParser._pending, which Python 3.12 uses as a
  private token buffer: close() did ''.join(self._pending) and cleared the entry,
  silently dropping the second image of every multi-image page. Renamed.
- _find_open_tag only matched double-quoted class attributes; archived HTML also
  uses single quotes and bare values.
- resolve_image treated a successful CDX/replay ('ok') as a failure class and
  reported non-image bodies as confirmed archive gaps. Gap now requires zero
  captures; a non-image body is bad_body; timeouts/throttles stay transient.
- pick_capture no longer discards captures whose CDX mimetype is text/plain or
  text/html (Tumblr CDN rows are often mislabelled), so real images stay reachable.
- Hebrew fixtures replaced with the alt text of the real 20150119072952 capture,
  encoded as numeric character references to prove exact round-tripping. No bidi
  reordering is applied: archived HTML stores logical order." && git log --oneline -1
